name: Azure Beat
description: Strike on a slow clean beat taken from the turning of the sky.

name: Sky Delay
description: Slow the time of the air above the head so falling blows lose their weight.

name: Moment Sight
description: See the next moment as a faint blue outline before it arrives.

name: Blue Pause
description: Lay a pause on an opponent's body that holds it a moment behind the rest of the fight.

name: Calm Instant
description: Hold an ally's wound in one calm instant while the body quietly finishes its mending.

name: Sky Quicken
description: Quicken an ally's pace under the open sky so that each step covers a little more ground.

name: Waning Taint
description: Let a taint in an ally age out of the body in a few breaths.

name: Blue Stall
description: Stall an opponent in a blue span of stretched time until the rest of the fight has moved on.

name: Sky Thread
description: Follow the thread of the next blow a heartbeat before it comes and turn it away.

name: Skyward Instant
description: Leap from one instant to the next across a wide gap.

name: Azure Moment
description: School move: hold a foe in one blue moment and strike once before that moment passes.

name: Echoed Beat
description: Strike on the same beat as an ally so that two blows land in one count.

name: Shared Pace
description: Share a quickened pace with one ally standing at the user's side.

name: Paired Sense
description: Read the pace of the ally beside the user and the foe before them in one glance.

name: Matched Slow
description: Hold a guard that slows blows in step with an ally's guard beside it.

name: Joint Delay
description: Stall an opponent between two cultivators so that neither side of them can move on.

name: Paired Quicken
description: Quicken two allies in step so that both move a pace ahead of the foe.

name: Shared Mend
description: Share the quickened mending of one hand with a wounded ally standing beside the user.

name: Joint Purge
description: Age a taint out of one ally by linking hands with a second and passing it between them.

name: Paired Stall
description: Stall the foe's advance between two cultivators while a shared ward holds both.

name: Beat Lance
description: Cast one lance together with an ally on a single beat so the point arrives doubled.

name: Shared Moment
description: Hold a moment shared between two allies in which any art aimed at them stops and both are hastened.

name: Mirrored Accord
description: School move: two cultivators hold their moments in step so the foe is sealed in the gap between them and both allies gain a pace.

name: Bound Pace
description: Bind the body by oath to a set pace and keep it through the fight.

name: Vow Beat
description: Strike on the beat at which the vow is spoken.

name: Tempo Read
description: Watch the tempo of the ground and note when a stranger breaks it.

name: Vow Slow
description: Slow the foes who have heard the vow until they move one beat behind.

name: Vow Quicken
description: Quicken each ally who has sworn the vow by one full pace.

name: Bound Mend
description: Mend an oath-sworn ally's wound with a quick even pulse that lasts as long as the vow.

name: Vow Stall
description: Stall the qi of a foe in the span of a spoken vow and hold it until the vow ends.

name: Tempo Spear
description: Cast a spear whose tempo is set by the vow so it cannot be matched or turned in time.

name: Vow Instant
description: Cross a long distance in one instant at the close of the vow.

name: Oathbound Moment
description: School move: hold the foe in the moment of the oath and hasten each ally who swore it.

name: Bare Span
description: Read a span of time laid open with nothing hiding the pace of any body in it.

name: Bare Tempo
description: Strike on a beat that the opponent can plainly hear and cannot answer.

name: Bare Instant
description: Stretch a single plain instant to turn aside one blow in the open.

name: Open Delay
description: Lay a plain delay on a foe in the open with no cover for it to hide behind.

name: Core Quicken
description: Quicken an ally with time drawn from the formed core and given in plain air.

name: Bare Mend
description: Hasten the mending of an ally's wound in the open with a steady unhidden pulse.

name: Bare Purge
description: Age a poison out of an ally by running the core's time through them in the open.

name: Bare Lance
description: Cast a lance whose time is held open and plain so it lands where the line ends.

name: Wide Stall
description: Stall every foot on a wide stretch of ground in one long held moment.

name: Core Span
description: Open a span of time from the core over a wide front and slow all that move in it.

name: Unwalled Instant
description: School move: hold a wide ground in the open in one moment where no foe can strike or cast.
